positions.name: BranchHoursAccessVersusStaffing
positions.frame: How are opening hours weighed when earlier access for one group of users is set against keeping staffing flat?
positions.why: Both statements set out one schedule change for the same two days: an 8am opening so commuters can return books, and an hour-earlier close to keep staffing flat. The frame reads both as one trade-off between access and staffing cost. Neither statement is a narrative's only support, and no existing stratum or narrative names opening hours, so no placement is proposed.
